tasks.title: Define and test simulated video-job API contract
tasks.objective: Document authenticated request, job state/progress, download URI and error responses for the synthetic 300-second flow, without exposing paid provider operations.
acceptance: API contract published with example JSON and auth requirements
Negative-path authentication and error tests pass
Provider enablement remains disabled by default

tasks.title: Integrate synthetic scenes into non-billable job lifecycle
tasks.objective: Wire the validated synthetic generator through job transitions and durable artifact handling without paid providers.
acceptance: Prompt request creates a job and defined scene plan

acceptance: Authenticated user can submit a prompt
Job progress and recoverable errors are shown
Completed synthetic MP4 is playable and downloadable
API tokens are not displayed or logged

tasks.title: Prove full prompt-to-download synthetic 300-second acceptance
